title: Hello, GPU
brief: Query the device, time a device-to-device copy with CUDA events, and report its bandwidth against the A100's copy ceiling.
hints: torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0) has name, total_memory, multi_processor_count, and major and minor for the compute capability.
A copy reads every byte once and writes it once, so it moves 2 * n_bytes. Count both.
cuda_time(fn) from lab_common returns the median milliseconds of one call to fn, measured with CUDA events.
